# `nlink-lab lint`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Style and portability advice for a topology file (never blocks deploy).

Missing `validate` blocks, background processes without a healthcheck, one-sided impairments, disconnected node groups, no description. `--strict` exits 2 on any finding; `--allow RULE` silences one.

Usage: nlink-lab lint [OPTIONS] [TOPOLOGY]

Arguments:
  [TOPOLOGY]
          Path to the topology file (.nll)

Options:
      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Set NLL parameters (can be repeated: --set key=value)

      --allow <RULE>
          Silence one lint rule (repeatable)

      --strict
          Exit 2 when any finding remains (CI gate)

      --list-rules
          Print every lint rule and exit

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
